title: Add service opens a blank form in a fixed order
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as an Owner/Admin or as a user with "Settings Service" enabled.
  2. In the left sidebar under Settings, open the "Maintenance" entry beneath "Inspection Templates" (if the build shows "Maintenance schedules" instead, use that entry and record the label). Schedules are shared by the whole organization, whichever location is chosen in the header.
  3. A schedule open in the editor that already has one routine service (e.g. "PM-A"), so that the covered step can show. Seed it with the standard steps (New schedule, Add service "PM-A", Every 3 months, save the service).
custom_steps:
1. Click Add service.
  2. Read the order of the sections down the form.
  3. Look for any send switch in the form and in the service table.
  4. Leave the name blank and try to save the service.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Add service opens a blank service form (no name, no values filled in).
  • The sections run: name, "Is this a compliance inspection?", triggers and intervals, services also covered, canned lines, reminder timing.
  • There is no send switch anywhere in the form or in the service table; the service has exactly one name (no separate customer-facing name).
  • The service cannot be saved with a blank name.
  • On the design the blank name shows the inline message "Enter a service name." (write down the words you see; do not pass or fail on the wording).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10559 (S2, Add a routine service to a schedule), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S2 (Add service; The form, in order); Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), artboard V1; read 6 Oct 2026.
